name: path-audit-v1
selection: Fixed convenience registry chosen before fetching these instruction contents or observing tool predictions. First existing root AGENTS.md, then CLAUDE.md. First four distinct eligible literal path references in document order per repository, up to 24 total in registry order. Retain every exclusion and all other extracted candidates. No replacement repositories or outcome balancing.
prior_exposure: Registry names were checked against the existing smoke and prospective registries, not against model training data or every historical conversation. New collection does not imply independent human review.
candidate_syntax: Simple single-backtick literals or inline Markdown link destinations. Relative portable tokens only, containing a slash or an explicitly listed file suffix. Exclude URLs, whitespace, interpolation, wildcards, absolute paths and parent traversal. Deduplicate by literal destination per document. Extraction is independent of scanner candidate recognition; full document remains available for context.
reference_task: Review each selected occurrence against the complete pinned tracked Git tree and its source context before running the frozen tool. A tracked concrete target is a negative control. An absent target is a review issue only when the text asserts or links to an existing repository path. Future/generated/example paths, package-relative ambiguity and aliases remain unresolved unless evidence resolves them. Git absence alone does not prove a defect.
tool_scope: Isolated whole selected root document, not native whole-repository discovery. Materialize a path-inventory projection with empty regular files and real directory names, plus exact selected document bytes. Do not install, build or execute upstream code. Read only this document via the published library's discover boundary; keep default path extraction/existence rules unchanged. Retain all dead-path findings and match selected predictions by exact source line and literal message destination. Unsupported aliases/host collisions cannot become confirmed absent paths.
freeze_order: Commit protocol before acquisition. Retain collection and AI-authored maintainer observations in a second commit before tool predictions. Record that commit in the final report. No rule changes during audit. All labels are provisional maintainer judgements, never independent human labels.
reporting: Report raw confusion counts and unresolved cases, not a general accuracy percentage. No positive references means recall unavailable. No model comparison, native Cursor observation, adoption or maintainer endorsement. If results inform changes, mark this audit as development evidence and use new inputs for any subsequent evaluation.
